newsitem.title: MEXICO: IMSA places shares on Mexico bourse.
newsitem.headline: IMSA places shares on Mexico bourse.

text.p: Mexican industrial firm Grupo IMSA SA placed 18 million equity units on the Mexican Bolsa Wednesday at a price of 16.63 pesos per indivisible unit, the Mexican Stock Exchange said.
The units, denominated as UBC shares, are made up of three B shares and two C shares. UBC shares were trading at 16.63 pesos at midday after hitting an early-morning high of 17.14.
"The shares began the day well but are being dragged down by the market as a whole now," one dealer said. The Mexican Bolsa's leading IPC index was down about 1.6 percent at 3,252 at midday.
IMSA, which has interests in steel processing, automobile batteries and construction, also placed American Depositary Shares on the New York Stock Exchange at a price of $19 per ADS.
Each ADS is made up of nine UBC shares. IMSA ADSs were trading at 19-1/8 at midday.
